headline: Video: MI Head Reveals Effect of Removal of 8 Indonesian Stocks from MSCI Index
summary: A market analyst discusses the effect of eight Indonesian stocks being removed from the MSCI index. The article details were limited in the source description.
why: MSCI indexes are widely tracked by global passive funds, so removals from them can trigger fund rebalancing and selling of the affected shares.
why_moved: Removal from an MSCI index typically prompts index-tracking funds to sell the affected shares, which can pressure their prices.
original_headline: Video: Bos MI Ungkap Efek Keluarnya 8 Saham Indonesia Dari Indeks MSCI
